title: Timing functions compared
summary: Four bars slide the same distance on hover with ease, ease-out, linear and a bouncy cubic-bezier.
explanation: Hover the track: all four bars slide right over the same 600ms, but each follows a different timing function, so they move at different speeds along the way.

ease-out starts fast and slows down, which feels responsive. linear moves at a constant speed, which looks mechanical for most UI. The cubic-bezier overshoots past the end and settles back, a gentle bounce.
transition-duration and transition-timing-function are written separately here so each bar can override just the timing.
tryThis: Hover the grey track and watch where each bar is half-way through.
Change transition-duration to 1500ms to see the curves more clearly.
Give the last bar steps(5): it jumps in five steps.
